products.name: Black Bottom
products.summary: A stereo FET-style compressor for drums, bass and vocals. Fast, punchy, and it gets dirty when you push it.
products.description: Black Bottom is a stereo FET-style compressor from Bombest Audio. AU, VST3 and AAX for macOS, Apple Silicon and Intel. $29, with a free trial.

image.alt: The Black Bottom plugin window: INPUT and OUTPUT knobs either side of a gain reduction meter, with ATTACK, RELEASE, RATIO buttons 4, 8, 12, 20 and ALL, and MIX along the bottom.

intro: Black Bottom is a stereo FET-style compressor. I made it for the music I work on: funk, hip hop, rap and R&B. Reach for it when you want energy, punch and character, not invisible level control.

The low end is where it lives. Push INPUT and the bottom gets thick before it gets loud. The detector is high-passed at 90 Hz, so the kick and the bass don't yank the whole mix down. Work it hard and a little hiss breathes with the compression, the way a hard-worked hardware unit does.
Flip CLEAN for the classic FET sound. Same knobs, same ratios, no added color and no hiss.

controls.name: Input
controls.text: How hard you drive it. More input, more compression, more grit.

controls.name: Attack
controls.text: 1 is slowest (800 µs) and lets the hit through. 7 is fastest (20 µs) and grabs the front of it.

controls.name: Release
controls.text: 1 is slowest (1.1 s), 7 is fastest (50 ms). It slows down the longer it's been working, like the hardware.

controls.name: Ratio
controls.text: ALL is every ratio button in at once: harder, grabbier, dirtier.

controls.name: Mix
controls.text: Blend the dry signal back in for parallel compression, right on the channel. At 0% you get your dry signal, untouched.

controls.name: Clean
controls.text: The same compressor without the Black Bottom color: no low-end grit, no hiss.

controls.name: Meter
controls.text: The needle and the readout show gain reduction.

products.presetsIntro: 13 presets, dialed in on real dry drums, bass and vocal and level-matched, so switching presets changes the character, not the volume.
